blurb: The Eureka Day School in Berkeley is a bastion of progressive ideals. Every week over artisanal scones, the school board works to preserve a culture of inclusivity. But when a mumps outbreak threatens the community, facts become subjective and every solution divisive. This sharp comedy confronts the central question of our time: How do you build consensus when no one can agree on truth?
